question: The fundamental objective of the second five year plan was to initiate and accelerate the process of ________ so that the development of Indian economy takes a firm base.
solution:
The correct answer is __**industrialisation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The second five-year plan (1956-61) of India was primarily focused on **industrialisation** to build a self-reliant economy.
 
• It was based on the **Mahalanobis model**, which emphasized the development of heavy industries and capital goods sectors.
 
• The plan aimed at reducing import dependency by promoting the establishment of **large-scale public sector enterprises**.
 
• Key industries such as **steel, machinery, and heavy engineering** received significant investments and support.
 
• The plan led to the establishment of major industrial projects like the **Bhilai Steel Plant** and the **Durgapur Steel Plant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mahalanobis Model**

 
 
• Developed by Indian statistician P.C. Mahalanobis, this model laid the framework for the second five-year plan.
 
• It emphasized the importance of heavy industry and aimed at a rapid industrialization of the Indian economy.
 
 
 
• **Public Sector Enterprises**
 
 
• The second plan focused on the establishment of public sector enterprises in key industries to promote self-sufficiency.
 
• PSUs like Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL) and Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) were established during this period.
 
 
 
• **Heavy Industry**
 
 
• Heavy industries include large-scale industries such as steel, machinery, and construction.
 
• These industries require significant capital investment and are crucial for building infrastructure.
 
 
 
• **Bhilai and Durgapur Steel Plants**
 
 
• The Bhilai Steel Plant was established in collaboration with the Soviet Union.
 
• The Durgapur Steel Plant was set up with British collaboration, marking significant industrial milestones.
